judgments.rationale: The existing draft reading for C0002 accurately and completely states all governing conditions, actor duties, timing, thresholds, and exceptions specified in F004 and F006. Because the statement is already independently complete and faithful to the available text, no change is needed.

The proposed summary removes the exception allowing practicable notice when the date of treatment requires leave to begin in less than 30 days, improperly substituting an unconditional 30-day requirement ('even if...'), which contradicts the explicit exception in F006.

The draft reading is already complete, accurate, and faithful. Populating optional component fields such as action and action_quote does not address any deficiency in governing meaning and is an unnecessary edit.
The proposal modifies the phrasing of the summary and populates optional component fields without making any necessary substantive correction to an already complete and faithful reading.

source_spans.quote: (2) Duties of employee In any case in which the necessity for leave under subparagraph (C) or (D) of subsection (a)(1) or under subsection (a)(3) is foreseeable based on planned medical treatment, the employee—

(B) shall provide the employer with not less than 30 days’ notice, before the date the leave is to begin, of the employee’s intention to take leave under such subparagraph, except that if the date of the treatment requires leave to begin in less than 30 days, the employee shall provide such notice as is practicable.
